item.title: LA Councilman Curren Price must stand trial on public corruption charges
item.description: Price has maintained his innocence. The Ninth District councilmember is charged with five counts of grand theft by embezzlement of public funds, four counts of conflict of interest and three counts of perjury by declaration.

item.title: Kam Woods, USC men edged by Iowa
item.description: Woods scores a career-high 33 points and rallies the Trojans from a 17-point second-half deficit, but Iowa’s Bennett Stirtz makes two free throws with 4.6 seconds left and the Hawkeyes hold on for a 73-72 win.

item.title: Swanson: USC’s Lincoln Riley bets big on Gary Patterson at defensive coordinator
item.description: Riley has hired a College Football Hall of Famer and two-time National Coach of the Year to shore up his defense, a move that could pay off handsomely or fail miserably.

item.title: Lauren Betts leads No. 2 UCLA past Illinois despite foul trouble
item.description: The All-American center picks up her second and third fouls late in the first quarter and sits out the second but finishes with 23 points and nine rebounds as the Bruins win their 14th consecutive game, 80-67.

item.title: Why new USC defensive coordinator Gary Patterson returned to coaching
item.description: Patterson, now a Hall of Fame coach, is taking the reins of the Trojans’ defense with renewed perspective on the sport. “I’ve been out for three years, so I got a chance to watch more football and evaluate people about how you play defense, how the game is going,” he says.

item.title: Police arrest 3 men as part of probe into burglary ring targeting homes in Newport Beach, Irvine
item.description: Police say the suspects are linked to Newport Beach home burglaries and a suspected burglary plot in Irvine.

item.title: Lakers routed by Cavaliers in LeBron James’ emotional return to Cleveland
item.description: Luka Doncic returns from an early injury scare but his 29 points aren’t nearly enough to help the Lakers keep pace in the second half of a 129-99 loss. James gets choked up during a video tribute and has one of his worst games ever as an opponent in Cleveland.

item.title: Chargers hire Chris O’Leary as their new defensive coordinator
item.description: O’Leary, who was the Chargers’ safeties coach in 2024, replaces Jesse Minter, who left last week to become the Baltimore Ravens’ head coach.

item.title: UCLA men coast to victory over short-handed, slumping Oregon
item.description: Tyler Bilodeau has 18 points, Eric Daily Jr. adds a double-double and the Bruins handle a Ducks team that is missing three of its top four scorers, 73-57, for a third straight win.

item.title: St. Bernard boys basketball avenges loss against St. Anthony to remain tied for first place
item.description: St. Bernard boys basketball defeats St. Anthony in a Del Rey League meeting
